verdict.rationale: The office publishes a recognized third-party role through the Electronic Register of Patent Agents and the facilitator (IP Mitra / Designs facilitator) lists. It also has a Forms & Official Fees page with downloadable statutory forms. None of the evidence shows an authorization or power-of-authority form, or rules on what an agent may or may not do. missing for 10: an explicit authorization form, a documented scope of agent powers and limits, a list of which signatures must remain personal to the applicant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
